arrival_order.heldout_metric: Frozen-order proxy recomputed with pass-2 PAVA baseline; not model validation.
arrival_order.optimistic_bound_metric: Independent single-pass optimum with unrestricted displacement; an optimistic relaxation.
arrival_order.limitation: Configured receiver-local tail surrogate; the recorded error proxy is unchanged. A margin below 4*error admits exploratory candidates without a positive conservative gain guarantee. gain-4*error is a lower bound only conditional on uniformly bounded observation error and this surrogate, not statistical confidence or model validity. Pass 2 is diagnostic only. Independent same-codec GPU measurement is required.
